name: baihua-local-ai-dsh-plugin
description: Baihua (百花) local-AI integration plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Auto-detects Baihua-provided local AI services (OpenVINO Model Server / OVMS, vision server, Baihua.AI OpenAI-compat shim), maintains a live capability table, registers local models as a DSH LLM provider route, and exposes a guarded small-task tool so DSH can offload tiny, bounded work to on-machine AI and reduce online token consumption.
